name: trade-pro-ai
description: TRADE PRO AI - AI trading analysis platform (Cloudflare Pages + D1)

scripts.db:inspect: npx wrangler d1 execute trade-pro-ai --remote --command "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"
scripts.db:backup: npx wrangler d1 export trade-pro-ai --remote --output backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 execute trade-pro-ai --remote --file migrations/0001_baseline_auth_tables.sql
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 execute trade-pro-ai --local --file migrations/0001_baseline_auth_tables.sql
